request.style: English, Christian hip hop storytelling, a hungry young male rapper with fast precise flow, a sung hook by a male choir, hard trap drums, 808 bass, orchestral brass stabs, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Valley of Elah, two armies on the hills
Nine foot giant talking big, giving everybody chills
Forty days he shouted, send a man to fight me
Saul's whole army shaking, nobody stepping up to try me
Then a shepherd boy came down with bread for his brothers
Heard the giant mocking God and said, I'll go if no other
Saul gave him armor but it didn't fit the frame
He took his staff and his sling and he went in the name

[Chorus]
Five smooth stones from the brook
One shot is all that it took
You come with a sword and a spear
I come in the name of the Lord, he is here

[Verse]
Goliath looked at David and he laughed at the kid
Come here, I'll give your flesh to the birds, that's what he said
David said, you come with a sword, a spear, a javelin
But I come in the name of the Lord of hosts, and he will win
He ran to the line, put a stone in the sling
Let it fly to the forehead and the giant hit the ground
The battle is the Lord's, let the whole earth know
There's a God in Israel, and he saves without a sword

[Chorus]
Five smooth stones from the brook
One shot is all that it took
You come with a sword and a spear
I come in the name of the Lord, he is here
